description: This header file declares utility functions and structures related to command execution and monitoring within the Cuttlefish project. It includes functions for reading exit codes, obtaining monitor connections, running launcher actions, and reading launcher actions from file descriptors, primarily dealing with inter-process communication.
external_methods: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance(const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific& instance_config, const int timeout_seconds)
Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitor(const CuttlefishConfig& config, int instance_num, int timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, LauncherAction action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, const run_cvd::ExtendedLauncherAction& extended_action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: A struct representing an action and its extended form for launcher operations.

methods.name: ReadExitCode
methods.description: Reads the exit code from the monitor socket, returning a Result encapsulating RunnerExitCodes.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance
methods.description: Obtains a SharedFD connection to the launcher monitor specific to a given Cuttlefish instance configuration, with a timeout.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitor
methods.description: Obtains a SharedFD connection to the launcher monitor based on general configuration, instance number, and timeout.

methods.name: ReadLauncherActionFromFd
methods.description: Reads a launcher action from the monitor socket, returning an optional LauncherActionInfo.

methods.name: WaitForRead
methods.description: Waits for data to be available for reading on the monitor socket within the specified timeout.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction
methods.description: Sends a launcher action request through the monitor socket, then waits for response and checks for errors. Overloaded to accept either a simple action or an extended action.
